sec.title: How Themis keeps claims safe
sec.sub: Five verifiable facts. No trust-me security.
sec.r1d: Drafts are computed deterministically. No AI bills, no third-party calls in local mode.
sec.r2d: Photos and policy text are processed in-session only and never used for model training.
sec.r3d: Emails, phones and long ID numbers are redacted before anything leaves the device.
sec.r4d: Single-use magic links, revoke-checked sessions, no passwords to phish.
sec.r5d: Claim timeline plus downloadable audit log on every report; human sign-off required.
